Jared (CSM): Morning team — kicking off Reef Health onboarding. Quick sync: stakeholders list below, success criteria, 60-day timeline. Need owners + any blockers by EOD. @Nina @Eli @Sophie
Nina Patel: Thanks Jared. I can lead enablement and initial 1:1s. Recommend preflight checklist: data connect, API keys, consent docs.
Eli Shaw: I'll handle integration tech runbook and readiness. Can we get their data volume & expected qps? cc @Marco for contract SLAs.
Sophie Li: I'll own the rollout timeline and run the kickoff workshop. Proposed dates:
```
Week1: Kickoff + env access
Week2: Integration dry run
Week3-4: Validation + tweaks
Week5-6: Pilot -> success criteria gating
```
Marco Hernandez: Sales notes — customer has a renewal window in 8 months, and enterprise discounts tied to adoption metrics. Risk: delayed data access = renewal risk. I'll monitor exec sponsorship.
Jared (CSM): Success criteria draft:
- 2 production-grade endpoints handling 500 qps sustained
- Average 95th latency < 250ms
- Error rate < 0.5%
- 3 internal teams trained + runbook accepted
Nina Patel: Enablement plan: 3 x 60min sessions, recorded + quickstart docs. Feedback capture: weekly NPS check-ins + shared Google sheet.
Eli Shaw: Need their model choices and preferred region. Also will set up staging GPU quota. Posting sample curl to test tokens:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/serve \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","prompt":"health-check"}'
```
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: "Customer Kickoff - Reef Health" in 48 hours.
Sophie Li: Blockers: legal signoff on data retention, and their infra team isn't available Thurs. Can we move workshop to Fri? @Marco can you confirm?
Marco Hernandez: Friday works. Legal is tracking; expecting sign-off by Wednesday. I'll escalate if not.
Jared (CSM): OK moving kickoff to Fri 10am PT. Action items:
- Marco: confirm legal by Wed EOD
- Nina: prep enablement slides + attendee list
- Eli: prep runbook + test token by Thu
- Sophie: update calendar and send invites
I'll follow up with a short agenda. :rocket:
Nina Patel: Adding risk tag: "renewal-risk:high" until integration completes. We'll re-evaluate after pilot.
Eli Shaw: Tagging tech-debt item: "staging-quota" — creating ticket now: #INT-4821
Sophie Li: Agenda draft posted in Google doc: link (https://docs.google.com/.../reef-kickoff). Please add notes.
Jared (CSM): Great — thanks team. If anything else pops up add to thread. /me ✅
